$description: Paper Pixel - a heyrav world. base: any theme; light/dark: per theme; voice: words reworded in this world. Keys are token names without the --.
name: Paper Pixel
line: The page as paper: pixel plants fold up from its lines, and a line-drawn cat chases the pointer, which is a feather on a string.

voice.searchph: Search the garden: components, tokens, patterns
voice.hero.p: Every token, component and pattern behind heyrav.in, on paper. Plants stand on the lines; a cat keeps an eye on the pointer.
voice.lede.worlds: One system, many worlds. In this one the page is paper: pixel plants fold up from its lines, a cat lives on it, and the pointer is a feather on a string.
voice.lede.icons: Pixel line icons, drawn on the same grid as the plants.
voice.lede.button: A filled button on a thick card edge: it presses down into the page. A success grows a flower beside it.
voice.lede.card: A sheet of paper with a soft shadow, lifting a little under the pointer.
voice.lede.morph: Plant it: an arc while it grows, In bloom when it is done - with a flower to show for it.
voice.copyfail: That slipped - select the code instead
voice.lede.404: Nothing grows here. Search, or go back to the first page.
